Name: Send Vote Email
Author: Admin
Description: Use the Send Vote Email action to send emails with the predefined answering options. This action uses Google SecOps HTML templates to format the email. With appropriate permissions, the Send Vote Email action can send emails from a mailbox other than the default one. This action doesn't run on Google SecOps entities.

Parameters.Description: An optional email address from which to send an email if permissions allow it. By default, the email is sent from the default mailbox that is specified in the integration configuration.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email recipients, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email CC field, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of email addresses for the email BCC field, such as user1@example.com, user2@example.com.
A comma-separated list of paths for file attachments stored on the server, for example, /{FILE_DIRECTORY}/file.pdf, /{FILE_DIRECTORY}/image.jpg.
The type of the HTML template to use. The default value is Email HTML Template.
The structure of the vote to send to recipients. The possible values are Yes/No or Approve/Reject. The default value is Yes/No.

A comma-separated list of recipients to use in the Reply-To header. Use the Reply-To header to redirect reply emails to the specific email address instead of the sender address that is stated in the From field.

A location where the attachments are stored. By default, the action attempts to upload attachments from the Cloud Storage bucket. The possible values are GCP Bucket or Local File System. The default value is GCP Bucket.

AIDescription:
The 'Send Vote Email' action allows users to send interactive emails containing predefined voting options (Yes/No or Approve/Reject) using the Microsoft Graph API. This action is designed to facilitate quick decision-making or approvals directly from an email recipient's inbox. It utilizes Google SecOps HTML templates to format the email body and supports sending from delegated mailboxes if the configured account has the necessary permissions.

### Parameters Description

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Send From | String | Yes | The email address from which the email will be sent. Defaults to the mailbox specified in the integration configuration. |
| Subject | String | Yes | The subject line of the email. |
| Send to | String | Yes | A comma-separated list of recipient email addresses. |
| CC | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses to be included in the CC field. |
| BCC | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses to be included in the BCC field. |
| Attachments Paths | String | No | A comma-separated list of file paths for attachments. |
| Email HTML Template | String | Yes | The name of the HTML template to use for the email body. |
| Structure of voting options | String | Yes | Defines the voting buttons shown to the user. Options are 'Yes/No' or 'Approve/Reject'. |
| Reply-To Recipients | String | No | A comma-separated list of email addresses to redirect replies to. |
| Attachment Location | String | Yes | Specifies where the attachments are stored: 'GCP Bucket' or 'Local File System'. |

### Additional Notes
- This action does not process or interact with Google SecOps entities (IPs, Hostnames, etc.).
- Attachments are limited to a maximum size of 20MB.
- The action automatically handles Right-to-Left (RTL) formatting if detected in the HTML template.

### Flow Description
1. **Parameter Extraction and Validation**: The action retrieves all input parameters and validates that any specified attachment paths exist in the chosen storage location (GCP or Local).
2. **Mailbox Setup**: It validates the 'Send From' mailbox to ensure the integration has access to it.
3. **Email Construction**: The action prepares the email payload, including the HTML body, attachments, and the specific metadata required by Microsoft Outlook to render voting buttons.
4. **Draft Creation and Dispatch**: It creates a draft message in the sender's mailbox and then triggers the send command.
5. **Verification**: After sending, the action polls the 'Sent Items' folder to retrieve the final metadata of the sent email.
6. **Result Reporting**: The action returns the sent email's details as a JSON result and provides a success message.
